summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Gregory Porto portfolio. All major functionality working correctly including English/Portuguese language switching, responsive design, navigation, and content display.
passed_tests: Page loads in English with correct hero content (CLOUD · DEV · SECURITY, Cloud & Infrastructure Specialist in Evolution)
Hero subtitle and description display correctly
Navbar shows GP logo, Gregory Porto text, all navigation links, EN|PT switcher, LinkedIn/Instagram icons
About section displays Gregory Porto title with 4 paragraphs and Current Focus sidebar with 4 items
Skills section shows 6 cards in grid layout (Cloud & AWS, Networking, IT Support, Cybersecurity, DevOps, Technical Consulting)
Experience section shows timeline with 5 roles, first role 'Systems Analyst - Alimentos Toscana' with green dot and bullet points
Projects section shows 4 cards with Problem/Action/Result structure (not images)
Lab section shows 4 cards with dashed borders (AWS VPC, Docker Compose, Linux Hardening, CI/CD Pipeline)
Contact section shows 'build something solid' title with LinkedIn and Instagram buttons
Footer shows GP logo, Gregory Porto text, social icons, and current year
Language switching to Portuguese works correctly (Hero becomes 'Especialista em Cloud e Infraestrutura em evolução', About shows PT paragraphs)
All navigation links scroll to correct sections (#sobre, #skills, #experiencia, #projetos, #lab, #contato)
Mobile responsive at 375px: hamburger menu works, all sections stack properly, mobile language switcher functional
No layout overflow at 2400x1000 viewport, content properly centered
Hero CTA button and scroll down button work correctly
